title: 道德与人性（两套规则）

source.kind: 历史会话 Bash 调用 local_typeset.py（CLI 参数原样）

text.title: 越是道德观念重的人，|现实中往往越是过得没那么好，
text.body: 因为道德和人性它本来就是两套规则，|一个人道德观念过重，那么他的生存能力就不会很强，|因为它是不符合人性的，|或者是说它会限制一个人变好和成长。
text.en: The more moral a person is, the worse they often fare in real life, because morality and human nature are two separate sets of rules. When morality weighs too heavily on someone, their instinct for survival is not strong, for it runs against human nature - or rather, it holds them back from becoming better and growing.
text.credit: 原作 雅克-路易·大卫《苏格拉底之死》1787 · 新古典主义 · 暗石壁 暖褐 白袍
